# Collion: Kai'Sa & ADC coaching

> Collion is one of only two Challenger Kai'Sa one-tricks: peak #2 Kai'Sa worldwide, #1 Kai'Sa in the minor regions and #1 Kai'Sa one-trick in KR, EUW and NA on onetricks.gg (November 2026). He offers 1-on-1 League of Legends ADC and Kai'Sa coaching in English, live on Discord, for 25 EUR per hour (plus an optional 15 EUR data deep-dive of your recent ranked games).

## Coaching
- Coach: Challenger ADC from Hungary with a BSc and an MSc in Computer Science; the data deep-dive runs your ranked games through his own analysis pipeline. 2nd at the 2014 Hungarian LoL Nationals (512 teams).
- How a session goes: OP.GG pattern check, pick the games that show your weaknesses, full game review backed by statistics, you summarise and get a written bullet-point summary, optional live coaching.
- Focus: early laning phase, mid-game macro and teamfighting for ADC players. Kai'Sa players get champion-specific detail.
- Book: apply at https://collionlol.github.io/#apply (Discord name, OP.GG, what to fix; he DMs you on Discord, nothing paid until you have talked), or join https://discord.gg/yXxABBHcGC and DM `collion`.
